# Neon Asteroid Dodge

An endless runner for HTML canvas: a neon‑styled spaceship moves horizontally across a scrolling starfield while randomly spawning asteroids descend. The player uses arrow keys (or mouse) to dodge; any collision ends the game. Score is measured by survival time.

1: // Minimal Neon Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Set canvas size to fill its CSS dimensions or default 800x600
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   const width = canvas.width;
12:   const height = canvas.height;
13: 
14:   // Create a neon gradient background
15:   const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
16:   bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#001');
17:   bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#000');
18: 
19:   // Player ship
20:   const ship = {
21:     w: 40,
22:     h: 20,
23:     x: width / 2 - 20,
24:     y: height - 40,
25:     speed: 5,
26:     color: '#0ff',
27:   };
28: 
29:   // Stars for background
30:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
31:     x: Math.random() * width,
32:     y: Math.random() * height,
33:     z: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
34:   }));
35: 
36:   const asteroids = [];
37:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
38:   const asteroidInterval = 800; // ms
39:   let score = 0;
40:   let startTime = performance.now();
41:   let gameOver = false;
42: 
43:   // Sounds
44:   const spawnSound = new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/mechanical/sounds/mechanical-click-1.mp3');
45:   const collisionSound = new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/button/sounds/button-10.mp3');
46: 
47:   const keys = {};
48:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
49:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
50: 
51:   function drawShip() {
52:     // Neon glow for ship
53:     ctx.save();
54:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
55:     ctx.shadowColor = ship.color;
56:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
57:     ctx.beginPath();
58:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
59:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y - ship.h);
60:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
61:     ctx.closePath();
62:     ctx.fill();
63:     ctx.restore();
64:   }
65: 
66:   function spawnAsteroid() {
67:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
68:     asteroids.push({
69:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
70:       y: -size,
71:       w: size,
72:       h: size,
73:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 2,
74:       color: '#f0f',
75:     });
76:     // Play spawn sound
77:     spawnSound.currentTime = 0;
78:     spawnSound.play();
79:   }
80: 
81:   function drawAsteroids() {
82:     // Neon asteroids with glow and gradient
83:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
84:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
85:         a.x + a.w / 2,
86:         a.y + a.h / 2,
87:         a.w * 0.1,
88:         a.x + a.w / 2,
89:         a.y + a.h / 2,
90:         a.w / 2
91:       );
92:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
93:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#f0f');
94:       ctx.save();
95:       ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
96:       ctx.shadowColor = '#f0f';
97:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
98:       ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h);
99:       ctx.restore();
100:     });
101:   }
102: 
103:   function updateAsteroids(delta) {
104:     asteroids.forEach(a => (a.y += a.speed * (delta / 16)));
105:     // Remove off‑screen
106:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
107:       if (asteroids[i].y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
108:     }
109:   }
110: 
111:   function drawStars() {
112:     // Neon stars with glow
113:     ctx.save();
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
115:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
116:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
117:     stars.forEach(s => {
118:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.z, s.z);
119:       s.y += s.z * 0.5;
120:       if (s.y > height) {
121:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
122:         s.y = 0;
123:         s.z = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
124:       }
125:     });
126:     ctx.restore();
127:   }
128: 
129:   function checkCollision() {
130:     for (const a of asteroids) {
131:       if (
132:         ship.x < a.x + a.w &&
133:         ship.x + ship.w > a.x &&
134:         ship.y < a.y + a.h &&
135:         ship.y + ship.h > a.y
136:       ) {
137:         return true;
138:       }
139:     }
140:     return false;
141:   }
142: 
143:   function drawScore() {
144:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
145:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
146:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}` , 10, 20);
147:   }
148: 
149:   function loop(timestamp) {
150:     const delta = timestamp - (loop.last ?? timestamp);
151:     loop.last = timestamp;
152: 
153:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
154:     drawStars();
155:     // Ship movement
156:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
157:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed;
158:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
159:     drawShip();
160: 
161:     // Asteroids
162:     if (timestamp - lastAsteroid > asteroidInterval) {
163:       spawnAsteroid();
164:       lastAsteroid = timestamp;
165:     }
166:     updateAsteroids(delta);
167:     drawAsteroids();
168: 
169:     // Score
170:     score = (timestamp - startTime) / 1000;
171:     drawScore();
172: 
173:     // Collision
174:     if (checkCollision()) {
175:       // Play collision sound
176:       collisionSound.currentTime = 0;
177:       collisionSound.play();
178:       gameOver = true;
179:     }
180: 
181:     if (!gameOver) {
182:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
183:     } else {
184:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
185:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
186:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
187:       ctx.font = '48px monospace';
188:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
189:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2 - 20);
190:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
191:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, width/2, height/2 + 20);
192:     }
193:   }
194: 
195:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196: })();

(End of file - total 196 lines)
</content>
